description: Permanently delete a caller-owned template by ID. This cannot be undone. Library rows cannot be deleted. Returns JSON { templateId, deleted: true }. Mirrors DELETE /api/v1/templates/:id.

templateId.description: Template ID — slug for library rows (e.g. 'invoice-classic') or UUID for user rows.

name: delete_template

deleted.description: Always true; a failed delete is a tool error.

templateId.description: Template ID: a slug for library templates, a UUID for your own.

title: Delete template
